name: Tammy Two-Stroke
blurb: A chain-smoking auntie on a dirt bike.

look.description: Big sunglasses, a sun visor over a frosted perm, a cigarette that never seems to burn down. Rides a mud-caked dirt bike with a cooler strapped behind the seat.

meta.notes: Florida local, Swamp Kin. M4 rivals-1 (built early): a scrapper. Quick off the line, never backs down whatever her health, and goes straight back at whoever just hit her for a few seconds. Throwing roadside junk waits for weapons-2's throw behaviour. Rivalry: Deacon Vane; she has heard his sermon before. Prefers a tire iron (weapons-2 adds it). Rides the starter bike until her dirt bike exists. Not in any event yet (events are the riders lane's). Approved line: "Honey, I've passed hearses faster than you."
